listing.name: Fleet Logistics
listing.summary: Adds a new ship that reduces the fuel and supply consumption of the player's fleet.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new ship that reduces the fuel and supply consumption of the player's fleet.

description:
A small mod for big fleets.

This mod introduces a new ship, called Fleet Overseer, which reduces the fuel and supply consumption of the player's fleet.

link

Spoiler
Fleet Observer:

Features:
A new ship

Config file to change the consumption reduction, located at data/config/settings.json (default reduction is 30%)
(A new industry skill (needed for the mod to work))

As this mod doesn't change any existing thing in the game, it should be compatible with every mod.

The Fleet Overseer ship can be bought from the Independents, but if they don't seem to sell it,
you can change its chance to show up in the data/world/factions/default_ship_roles.json file

aiDescription: Adds a new ship called Fleet Overseer that reduces the fuel and supply consumption of the player's fleet. Includes a configuration file to adjust the consumption reduction percentage and a new industry skill required for the mod to function. The ship can be purchased from Independents, with its availability adjustable via faction ship role settings.
